profile_evidence: Retained native run namelist uses mode3, non_hydrostatic=true, diff_opt=1, km_opt=1, damp_opt=0; log shows HEVI off, WRFParity mass mode1, wrf_w_damping=0, implicit_wdamp=1. Earlier non_hydrostatic off print predates subsequent true setter and Tile construction, per prior authority audit.

ImplicitOnly sets do_implicit=true and do_explicit=false; Steps7-10 diffusion and Rayleigh are in do_explicit block. This does not mean diffusion is globally disabled or irrelevant to slow explicit stages.
WRF W damping requires wrf_w_damping==1 and implicit_wdamp; it is off under logged effective setting. Additional test top damping code is commented out.
routes: Within active implicit block EOS p_pert_mass feeds U PGF, synchronized p_pert_ feeds V PGF, and p_pert_mass feeds W interior and top PGF; U/V owner should establish their full routes.

W live pressure force uses p(k)-p(k-1), top one-sided pressure, and column-mass buoyancy. Its old EOS-alt interpolation is dead as documented in source; al_pert/alt affect U/V PGF, not directly this W PGF.
p_pert_w/p_full_w computed for diagnostics but do not enter W forcing; debug sanitization of p_pert_ is a conditional separate path.
alt reciprocal density in diffusion and pressure from p_pert_ for diffusion live in do_explicit; they are not active for Newton ImplicitOnly. Avoid importing slow-RHS bound into fast-only sum.

w_bound.conversion: At fixed coefficients, WRFParity path has msfty^-1*g pressure factor, times velocity_mass/(level_mass/msfty), then final division by velocity_mass; cancellation is exact-real only. Must account independently for all native FP operations and any sanitizer/branch.
w_bound.projection: Final packed Q_w extends mass-grid values by copy: infinity norm 1, unweighted L2 norm at most 2 for standard two-axis alias groups; weighted S_inv requires actual per-cell weights or a proved bound.
w_bound.units: E_p in Pa; resulting W tendency error in the solver W tendency units after actual hybrid-mass and map factors; convert through recorded inverse S and same N before comparing dimensionless RMS.

missing: Numeric same-call g, cqw/cq1, rdn and top rdnw, c1f/c2f, mu/mub, msfty, actual S_inv and ownership layout; recorded context hashes are not values. EOS raw bundle includes pressure/alt/alb, mu/mub, c1h/c2h and rdnw, but no raw c1f/c2f,cqw,rdn,msfty or S_inv.

Map/level mass/velocity denominator positivity and no sanitizer activation, finite coefficients, identity of reference states, signs and exact active terms require verification at each captured endpoint.

A bound on native arithmetic roundoff in W path and other RHS terms and complete L2 weighted accumulation remains necessary for e_i. All-array vs physically owned cells must be identified; avoid assigning saved alias-inclusive EOS norm directly to owned-cell norm.
